body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target moves 2 units through ordinary difficult terrain without extra cost. It may pass through one willing creature's space, but not walls.

surges.html: The movement does not trigger movement Reactions from one chosen detected enemy.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Phantom
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Phantom Full Manifestation (FM-1P). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
